label: human oversight
definition: A design and development approach ensuring high-risk AI systems can be effectively overseen by natural persons during use.
source_quote: High-risk AI systems shall be designed and developed in such a way, including with appropriate human-machine interface tools, that they can be effectively overseen by natural persons during the period in which they are in use.

label: automation bias
definition: The tendency of automatically relying or over-relying on the output produced by a high-risk AI system.
source_quote: to remain aware of the possible tendency of automatically relying or over-relying on the output produced by a high-risk AI system (automation bias), in particular for high-risk AI systems used to provide information or recommendations for decisions to be taken by natural persons

label: stop button
definition: A procedure allowing the intervention in the operation of a high-risk AI system or interrupting it to bring it to a safe state.
source_quote: to intervene in the operation of the high-risk AI system or interrupt the system through a 'stop' button or a similar procedure that allows the system to come to a halt in a safe state

label: separate verification by at least two natural persons
definition: A requirement ensuring no action or decision is taken on the basis of identification results unless verified and confirmed by at least two competent natural persons.
source_quote: no action or decision is taken by the deployer on the basis of the identification resulting from the system unless that identification has been separately verified and confirmed by at least two natural persons with the necessary competence, training and authority
